question_text: Read the following text and fill in each gap with a
stimulus: suitable word based on the information of the text.15 = 5 The environment must be protected and everyone must play a part of it. The consumer society is mainly accountable to the environment crisis. Before buying a thing one has to think of its necessity, sustainability and durability One should buy durable items and repair them when necessary. Thus many things when we no large use them. Recycling is a good way of using things properly. Otherwise, we can send goods to a landfill or have them burned up. Recycling drink and food cans will make less trash and lessen pollution. A company can also make new cans from the old ones. [Unit-5; Lesson-5] Everyone must play a part in (a) ⎯ the environment. Before buying a thing a buyer has to consider whether it is necessary. (b) ⎯ or selling of unusable things is a proper way. We can (d) ⎯ drink and food cans. It will lessen (e) ⎯ and pollution. | 214 Read the passage and answer the questions 4 and 5. Stephen Hawking is considered the greatest physicist after Einstein. He was born in England in 1942. He was skilled in Mathematics from the early age. He wrote the book 'A Brief History of Time : From the Big Bang to Black Hole in 1988. In this book he explains cosmology for the general public. It became famous and established his reputation as a great scientist. He was famous for his investigation into the origin of the universe.He received his Ph.D. in cosmology from Cambridge University in 1968. But fortune did not favour him. In 1972, he became a victim of Gehrig's disease. Since then he has been confined to a wheel chair with no power to control his body. But he continues his teaching through the help of computer. In 1974, he won the prestigious Albert Einstein award for theoretical physics. In 1979, he joined Cambridge University as Lucasian Proessor of mathematics. He is still carrying out his research work using his computer.
